title: A signed-out Get a Free Spotlight press opens the Spotlight builder, not the home page

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-17 (project thread): production fetch of /launch/start and /launch/step/spotlight?go=1 signed out both answered x-matched-path '/' (the home page)

detail: Every Get a Free Spotlight button links /launch/start. Signed out, that route holds the answers and sends the visitor to /launch/step/spotlight (owner 2026-11-13: the account is asked for at Publish), and the Create a Space wizard's Keep building link goes to the same step. The member layout redirected every signed-out request it did not list as a public view to '/', so the builder never rendered and the visitor saw the home page. Fix: lib/launch/destination.ts isAnonLaunchPage admits exactly /launch/step/spotlight, and the layout renders it in the public chrome. The page and its Publish action already served a signed-out visitor (publish holds the answers and sends them to /sign-in?next=/launch/claim). Rendered signed out at 390 and 1280 on a local dev server: the Spotlight form and the 'You make a free account when you publish' line show.

verify.note: Fails on main: the member layout has no public view for the Spotlight step, so a signed-out visitor is redirected to the home page. Passes once isAnonLaunchPage admits only /launch/step/spotlight and the layout reads it.
